statement: Copying is not heredity: a mechanism that duplicates bytes does not by itself transmit variation to descendants.
confidence_basis: Nestor S1-C re-adjudicated 1,031 candidate spontaneous replicators to 57 survivors; in 6,287 of 6,547 recombination-axis events the interaction moved <10% of the victim toward the donor and the post-interaction splice did the work.
known_confounds: the detector's own definition of a copy event; replay matching proves reproducibility, not heredity
untested_predictions: a substrate with copying but no transmissible variation shows no adaptive trend under selection
blocking the splice operator removes most apparent replicators without removing copying

evidence.verbatim: in 6,287 of 6,547 RECOMBINATION-axis events the interaction moved < 10% of the victim toward the donor; the post-interaction _mutate splice did it (Nestor S1-C, commit d7641744d)

statement: Where variation is available only after a successful reproduction, the birth interface is a bootstrap barrier: search cannot reach reproduction because it cannot vary before reproducing.
scope: endogenous-reproduction substrates whose mutation operator is gated behind a completed copy
confidence_basis: stated by the operator from Nestor's forensics; Atlas has the re-adjudication evidence but not yet a matched pre-reproductive-variation arm
known_confounds: population size and run length may dominate; the gate may be an implementation detail rather than a property of endogenous reproduction
untested_predictions: staged reproductive protocols (partial heredity before full copy) reach replication where all-or-nothing birth does not
more random restarts at the same birth interface yield no additional replicators

evidence.verbatim: non-pair worlds were not meaningfully searching because the mutation operator was gated behind reproduction (operator, 2026-09-24, from Nestor forensics)

statement: Task competence is not a generalizable mechanism: a system can pass its own assay while carrying nothing that transfers.
confidence_basis: SFE C4-07's mechanism reading was superseded by C5-08 while its numbers stood; Ensorain E0/E1/E1.5 closed INDETERMINATE with the governing gate failing (rank-1 unfolding beat the tensor train per parameter).
known_confounds: assay capability is often the real limit (SFE-03 INCONCLUSIVE: target unreachable by any arm)
untested_predictions: transplanting a competent organism into a matched world without its assay removes the apparent competence

evidence.verbatim: C4-07's mechanism READING that single-edit robustness is 'neutrality + length' understood as dead code is superseded by C5-08
INCONCLUSIVE (assay incapable: target unreachable by any arm at this budget)

statement: Information gating creates accessibility cliffs: a computation can be unreachable because the genotype-to-phenotype topology offers no rewarded path, even when information, substrate and selection are sufficient.
scope: NPE CW01 worlds; SFE damage/neutrality geometry
confidence_basis: Nestor CW01 cycle 8 measured an answer-before-read plateau and a 4-edit valley; SFE C4-01 found 1-3% of single edits between neutral and destroyed with D7=0 in 5,472 edits, replicated 5,586/5,586 in C5-05.
known_confounds: ruler conditioning (CW01 D086: relative-loss ruler ill-conditioned); representation layout confounded with distance
untested_predictions: incrementally reachable constants cross the same moat that atomic constants cannot
neutral bridges raise crossing rate without raising mean fitness

evidence.verbatim: The damage cliff: no single edit falls between neutral and destroyed

statement: Persistence is not causal self-maintenance: a structure can survive because nothing removes it rather than because it repairs or reproduces itself.
scope: continuous-field and spatial substrates; long-lived lineages in any engine
confidence_basis: no indexed experiment separates the two; Flow-Lenia-class substrates would be needed
known_confounds: lineage-longevity metrics count survival, not maintenance
untested_predictions: ablating a candidate's repair machinery shortens lifetime only where self-maintenance is real

statement: Reproduction machinery is not reproductive advantage: acquiring the means to copy does not imply out-competing those that lack it.
confidence_basis: the 57 surviving Nestor replicators have not been competed against non-replicators under matched resources
known_confounds: resource coupling and spatial structure decide takeover as much as the machinery
untested_predictions: seeded replicators fail to take over where reproduction is not resource-rewarded

statement: Organization is not reproduction: stable structured collectives can form without any level of the collective reproducing.
scope: spatial and chemistry substrates; DISHTINY-class worlds
confidence_basis: no Prometheus engine yet permits an evolvable organism boundary (catalogue matrix 2026-09-19)
known_confounds: entity detectors define the collective and so can manufacture it
untested_predictions: collectives detected with validated controls persist without collective-level reproduction

statement: Sustained propagation is not adaptive search: a population can persist indefinitely while exploring nothing.
confidence_basis: the frontier's flat-elite interpretation (100-180 generations of N=50 moving nothing on screened worlds with headroom) and Nestor's gated-mutation finding are two independent instances.
known_confounds: compute accounting (the flat elite may be a population-size artefact; interpretation still PROVISIONAL)
untested_predictions: a persistence metric and a search metric diverge under a frozen mutation operator

evidence.verbatim: The flat elite: 100-180 generations of N=50 move nothing on screened worlds with headroom

statement: Where a ruler is ill-conditioned, mechanism claims inherit its artefacts: measurement defects, not substrates, explain a large share of our reversals.
confidence_basis: 218 indexed defects; classes RECOVERY 28, SCIENCE_DEFECT 26, LANDSCAPE 21, BUG 20, MISSING_TELEMETRY 13, ASSAY_STATE 9; CW01 D086 (relative-loss ruler explodes on near-zero baselines) and D071 are the same class; the ASAL ruling turned on ruler authority.
known_confounds: only recorded defects count; undetected ones are invisible
untested_predictions: re-running any reversed claim under a well-conditioned absolute ruler changes its disposition

evidence.verbatim: the ruler cannot support a length-vs-robustness read as designed

statement: A clean null that removes a confound changes our model of the search space more than a positive result that leaves the confound standing.
confidence_basis: asserted by the operator and adopted as the policy's learning target; the Nestor 1,031-to-57 re-adjudication is the motivating case. Atlas has not yet scored enough experiments to test it empirically.
known_confounds: theory-delta scoring is Atlas's own judgment until the policy has outcome data
untested_predictions: experiments whose disposition fell but whose confound was removed precede more downstream findings than experiments whose disposition rose
